evidence: empty_void: In seg2:start the top 40% of the frame is empty dark gradient above two small circles. In hook@0.3 the bottom third is blank between the rows and the caption.

weakest_scene.visible_evidence: Two identical yellow circles, both labeled '70%' and both captioned '~20 years ago' (seg2:mid, seg2:end). The narration says 'Today it's just 35%'. A stray cyan ellipse sits over the left label.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The comparison machine got the same data point twice, so the 'today' value (35%) never reached the scene. The circles are a generic size comparison, not a depiction of drinkers.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Show 70% (~20 years ago) against 35% (today) as a scene that halves visibly. For example, a row of 10 young people where 7 hold drinks, then Data takes half the drinks away until only 3.5 remain. Remove the ellipse overlay and give each label its correct year.
